2610.12410.title: Predicting Alignment Generalization with Value Representations
2610.12410.paper_summary: LLM developers post-train their models to exhibit prosocial values and behavioral traits, which are enumerated in an alignment target. However, while recent post-training developments have yielded models that score highly on alignment evaluations, training models on sets of narrow behaviors still influences their behavior across unseen contexts and environments in unexpected ways. In this paper, we establish the task of alignment generalization prediction, i.e., predicting how fine-tuning a model to follow a given value changes its behavior across a wide range of held-out values. We conduct a large-scale analysis of alignment generalization effects across 66 values found in modern alignment targets, and benchmark representational techniques on the alignment generalization prediction task. We find that representations based on model activations when applying values in context significantly outperform methods based on textual descriptions of the values. Specifically, the best activations-based methods achieve correlations of 0.45 with our generalization matrix, compared with 0.05 from description-based baselines. We then show the applicability of representations that predict alignment generalization toward downstream tasks by using them to measure how similar the values in a multi-value alignment target are, which we find is significantly correlated with model robustness. Finally, we show initial evidence towards a shared, model-independent value space, which we use to develop the first taxonomy of LLM values grounded in empirical generalization dynamics. Our work demonstrates the importance of studying value generalization in LLMs and its application toward the more empirical design and training of model behavior.
2610.12410.paper_summary_zh: LLM 開發者對他們的模型進行後訓練，以展現社會價值觀和行為特徵，這些特徵在對齊目標中列舉。然而，儘管最近的後訓練發展產生了在對齊評估中得分很高的模型，但在狹窄行為集上訓練模型仍然會以意想不到的方式影響它們在未見上下文和環境中的行為。本文中，我們確立了對齊泛化預測的任務，即預測如何微調模型以遵循給定的價值觀會改變其在廣泛保留值範圍內的行為。我們對現代對齊目標中發現的 66 種價值的對齊泛化效應進行了大規模分析，並在對齊泛化預測任務上基準化了表示技術。我們發現，基於模型在上下文中應用價值觀時的激活的表示顯著優於基於價值觀文本描述的方法。具體而言，最佳的基於激活的方法在我們的泛化矩陣中達到了 0.45 的相關性，而基於描述的基準僅為 0.05。然後，我們展示了預測對齊泛化的表示在下游任務中的適用性，通過使用它們來衡量多值對齊目標中價值觀的相似性，我們發現這與模型的穩健性有顯著相關性。最後，我們展示了初步證據，支持一個共享的、模型獨立的價值空間，我們利用這個空間開發了第一個基於經驗泛化動態的 LLM 價值分類法。我們的工作展示了研究 LLM 中價值泛化的重要性及其在模型行為的更具經驗設計和訓練中的應用。
